title: Unprotected receipt inspection in finally skips every guard close
trigger: Producer has created its packet; saving w09-c19-main-producer.invocation.json then raises OSError after writing partial JSON. The stage except captures that failure, but its finally decodes the partial file before reaching the guard-close loop.
impact: JSONDecodeError replaces the original persistence failure; all acquired input/runtime/compiler/permit guards miss their close attempts and no stage closed receipt is produced. The same pre-loop region also contains unprotected receipt pin/read operations.
evidence: Exact original finally AST with memory-only path adapters and partial invocation JSON raised JSONDecodeError with zero guard close calls and zero cleanup rows; exec 1d639a outer/Python 0. No actual producer or Native was run.
required_fix: Put receipt inventory inspection and packet archival under independent error capture, and place every guard-close attempt in an outer guaranteed finally that cannot be skipped by those operations. Preserve original stage error plus inspection/archive/cleanup errors; do not claim unknown Job closure as true. Add pure controls for partial receipt JSON and pin/read OSError before closing. Keep this sealed Source unchanged and issue a successor.
